t: Railcraft greatly expands the types of tracks for Minecraft. It also turns the track creation process into a more immersive experience. The user crafts railbeds from ties and combines those railbeds with rails to create tracks of many different types.
铁路模组大幅拓展了《我的世界》中的轨道类型，同时也让轨道建造过程变得更加沉浸式。玩家需先用枕木制作道砟，再将道砟与铁轨组合，从而制成多种不同类型的轨道。
